faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the SJICSR Assistant Professor recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application for the SJICSR Assistant Professor positions is 11th August 2026. Ensure your application reaches the institute before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for the Assistant Professor post?
faq.answer: There are a total of 34 vacancies announced for the Assistant Professor positions across various specializations at SJICSR.

faq.question: Q3. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application process for the SJICSR Assistant Professor recruitment is strictly offline. Candidates need to download the form and send it via post.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Assistant Professor role?
faq.answer: Selected candidates for the Assistant Professor post will receive a monthly salary in the range of Rs. 79,800 to Rs. 2,11,500.

faq.question: Q5. What are the essential qualifications required for the Assistant Professor positions?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a DM/DrDNB/DNB or M.ch/DrNB/DNB in the respective specialization along with a Basic Course in Biomedical Research.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any age relaxation for reserved categories?
faq.answer: Yes, age relaxation is provided for SC/ST (45 years), Cat-I/IIA/IIB/IIIA/IIIB (43 years), and General (40 years) candidates.

faq.question: Q7. What is the application fee for different categories?
faq.answer: The application fee is Rs. 4,000 for General/OBC/PwBD candidates and Rs. 2,500 for SC/ST candidates.

faq.question: Q8. Where can I download the application form?
faq.answer: The application form can be downloaded from the official website of Sri Jayadeva Institute of Cardiovascular Sciences and Research: www.jayadevacardiology.com.

faq.question: Q9. What documents should be attached with the application form?
faq.answer: Candidates should attach self-attested copies of required documents such as photograph, signature, ID proof, and relevant certificates with the application form.

faq.question: Q10. Where should the completed application form be sent?
faq.answer: The completed application form should be sent to the address mentioned in the official notification through Speed Post or Registered Post.
